entries.summary: Train a compiled model with one optimizer update per minibatch; empty or omitted targets select experimental soft clustering.
parameters: X: nonempty batch of numeric samples; Y: matching targets, default omitted unsupervised.
epochs: nonnegative INT, default 1; batch_size: positive INT, default 1.
x_val/y_val: optional validation batches, equal sample counts; use [] placeholders when no validation is wanted.
regularization_lambda: numeric L2 contribution, default 0.0; callbacks: List[GESHA], default omitted.
entries.returns: Use as a KAFE statement. Python returns a history dictionary; KAFE has no supported declared dictionary/history value.
constraints: One output and one loss are supported by the training loop; no multi-output loss list or training dictionary API.
Cross-entropy classification logs loss and accuracy even when metrics=[]. MSE/MAE/soft clustering are loss-only.
Fit preprocessing only on training data; fit does not perform a split or automatic sample shuffle.
Callback monitors use only loss/accuracy/val_loss actually present. Preserve a final untouched test set.
Models use nested Python lists; bounded shape tests are not convergence/performance guarantees.

entries.summary: Predict numeric model outputs in evaluation mode.

entries.returns: Flat dense sample -> numeric output; batch -> List of per-sample outputs.
constraints: Wrap a single CNN [C,H,W], RNN [T,F] or embedding-token sample in a one-sample batch.
Nested first elements are interpreted as batch samples; no automatic architecture-aware single-sample detection.
Probability interpretation requires a suitable sigmoid/softmax output; clustering indices are arbitrary group IDs.

entries.summary: Read the ordered List[GESHA] layer collection.

entries.summary: Low-level single-sample forward pass; use predict for evaluation-mode batched inference.
parameters: sample: one correctly shaped numeric sample.
entries.returns: Numeric sample output; shape is architecture-dependent.
constraints: Forward does not automatically select evaluation mode; it updates layer caches needed by backward.
Model/Layer abstract definitions are protocols; instantiate a concrete factory result.
Direct mixed INT/FLOAT activation results can violate KAFE homogeneous-list validation.

entries.summary: Low-level reverse pass after a matching forward; normal fit calls this internally.
parameters: output_gradient: numeric list matching the previous output; optional numeric regularization_lambda defaults 0.0.
entries.returns: Sequential returns an input-gradient numeric list. Functional backward returns VOID in this backend.
constraints: Call only after the corresponding forward; caches are mutable training state.
Functional multi-output gradients are Python-backend functionality; intended gesha.functional uses one output.

entries.summary: Connect a layer to symbolic input/branch nodes; merge layers take List[GESHA] nodes.
parameters: node: GESHA input/node; nodes: compatible List[GESHA] for a merge.
constraints: Symbolic connection builds a graph, not numeric training data. Use one input/output in gesha.functional.
